description.en: Pachyrhinosaurus lakustai inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m technical art scale, not biological measure. Museum composite and TMP2005.053.0001 skull plus Fiorillo Tykoski 2012 Fig8C P.lakustai only. Flattened nasal boss, separate low brow bosses, solid living frill. Excluded historical art long nasal horns. Tail tip cropped in source, completed artistically; skin, color, pose and keratin thickness artistic.
